task: Implement automatic content-aware page breaks for Action Done Matrix (RU-F-033) that prevent print overflow, stop browser tables from crudely splitting across raw unformatted pages, allocate large panel remarks across authentic BukSU continuation sheets, and add a Balance Pages toolbar button.

changes.summary: Implemented estimateADMRowWeight, ADM_PAGE_CAPACITIES (Page 1: ~24 lines, Continuation: ~36 lines, Final Sheet: ~10 lines), and autoAllocateADMSheets; updated rowsByPage and autoPageCount to use content weights instead of hardcoded row count (4); added Balance Pages toolbar button (adm-balance-pages-btn); and added break-inside: avoid to table print CSS.
Added unit tests covering estimateADMRowWeight, autoAllocateADMSheets multi-sheet auto-distribution for large multi-paragraph panel suggestions, and the Balance Pages toolbar button (21/21 passed).

Added break-inside: avoid !important and page-break-inside: avoid !important to .adm-document-page table and tr in @media print, preventing browser print engines from splitting tables across raw unformatted paper boxes.
Recorded prevention rule, lessons learned, and runbook checklist for ADM content-aware dynamic page allocation and print integrity.

playwrightVisualLoop.autoAllocatedPages: verified dynamic multi-sheet generation without vertical overflow
playwrightVisualLoop.lightMode: verified clean sheet formatting with BukSU headers and footers
playwrightVisualLoop.darkMode: verified contrast immunity and high contrast buttons
playwrightVisualLoop.printEmulated: verified zero crude table splits and full format preservation
